_comment: Maps Tally form field IDs to MCF section types and database columns.
_warning: Tally returns field IDs (not labels) in webhook payloads. If the Tally form is edited, update this file — do not hardcode field IDs in application code.
_idempotency: The Tally submission ID (event.data.submissionId) is stored as clients.tallySubmissionId with a unique constraint. Duplicate webhooks are silently ignored.
